disclaimer: Editable planning estimates from the linked public API price pages, checked on 30 October 2026. Rates, availability and billing rules may change. App subscriptions, taxes, storage, local compute, electricity and labour are excluded. Image output rates may exclude input, thinking and other token charges. A zero API rate does not mean a production has no cost.

providers.model: Your notes or an existing brief
providers.note: Reusing notes without making an API call adds no planning API charge. Time, local tools and any existing subscriptions are outside this estimate.
Standard paid tier. Output includes thinking tokens. Grounding, caching and other tools can add charges.
Base token rates. Cache writes, tool use and some execution features have separate prices.
An existing transcript or a locally run transcription tool can avoid a hosted transcription API charge. Installation, hardware, electricity, time and transcript checking remain separate.
Published pay-as-you-go rate, billed per second. Multichannel duration and optional add-ons can increase the bill.
API rate of $0.22 per audio hour, converted here to minutes. Keyterm prompting and transcript editing are separately priced.
Reusing suitable existing imagery adds no image-generation API charge. Asset permissions, preparation and editing time still need consideration.

Output-image component only at 1K. Text/image inputs cost $0.50 per million tokens; text/thinking output costs $3 per million. These extra charges are not captured by the image-count line. Larger outputs cost more.
Legacy model listed in the official price guide at four credits per image; one credit equals $0.01. Check endpoint availability before selecting it.
Recording your own voice adds no synthetic-speech API charge. Recording equipment, performance, editing and your time are separate costs.
Legacy voice tier, equivalent to $4 per million characters after any eligible allowance. Count spaces and relevant markup. This estimate does not apply free allowances.
API price excluding taxes. Voice availability and the permissions needed for the intended use still need checking.

providers.model: Your footage or a local Blender scene
providers.note: Existing footage or a locally rendered Blender scene avoids a hosted video-generation API charge. Hardware, electricity, render time, asset permissions and labour are outside this estimate.
Rate with generated audio; one Runway credit equals $0.01. Audio defaults on. Some failed tasks can still be charged. Use all billable generated seconds, including alternative takes.
The same model through another host, with generated audio. 4K uses different rates. Availability, terms and limits can differ between hosts.
